package.description: Local-first screenshot and screen recording tool. Captures never leave your PC.

en-US.description: Local-first screenshot and screen recording tool. Captures never leave your PC.
en-US.longDescription:
Stinkshot freezes the screen, lets you select and annotate in place, and saves every capture to a plain folder you can use without the app.
Region, window, full-screen and scrolling capture; inline annotation with real redaction; OCR; pin to screen; MP4 and GIF recording with audio, webcam bubble and trim; searchable history.
No uploads, accounts or telemetry. The only network request is an opt-in, signature-verified update check.
en-US.name: Stinkshot
